info.name: Access Matrix
info.summary: Access matrix for Nextcloud applications by group
info.description:
Administrative access matrix for Nextcloud.
Shows an "application × group" matrix and lets an administrator grant or revoke access to an application with a single click, instead of typing group names by hand in "Settings → Apps → ⋯ → Allow access for users in certain groups".
Restrictions are stored in the standard Nextcloud mechanism (the application `enabled` appconfig key), so the matrix and the built-in administration interface always show the same data.
